blocks.title: Significant figures
blocks.text: Paimaish ke jin hindson ke bare mein hum maqool had tak yaqeen rakhte hain un ki tadaad significant figures kehlati hai; dar asal yeh us paimaish ke liye istemal hue asal instrument ki akkasi karte hain. Kisi bhi paimaish mein durust maloom hindse aur pehla andaza ya mashkook hindsa significant figures hain.

Calculator istemal karte hue kisi bhi hisab ka nateeja decimal ke baad bohat se hindse rakhta hai; yeh izafi hindse doosre shakhs ko un par yaqeen karne ki gumrahi de sakte hain, is liye nataij significant figures ki durust tadaad tak round off kiye jate hain. Yeh mushahidat record karte waqt instrument ki uncertainty ya least count ko samne rakh kar, aur hisab ke nataij significant figures ki durust tadaad tak likh kar kiya jata hai. Significant figures ki tadaad mein kisi ibham se bachne ko nateeja scientific notation mein likhna behtar hai. Maslan, ek hi cheez ko mukhtalif balances se tolna: electronic balance, mass = 3.145 +/- 0.001 g; lever balance, mass = 3.1 +/- 0.1 g. Aam taur par +/-0.001 g ya +/-0.1 g ki uncertainty chhor di jati hai, aur samjha jata hai ke likhe gaye adad mein aakhri hindse mein kam az kam 1 unit ki uncertainty hai. Scientists foran samajh jate hain ke 3.145 g ki report 3.1 g se zyada durust hai, jo behtar ya zyada precise instrument ki akkasi karti hai; jaise instruments aur techniques ka mayaar behtar hota hai, nataij zyada significant figures tak barhte hain aur tajurbati accuracy behtar hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Faasla (m) ka khara scale, upar 10^-20 se neeche 10^30 tak. Saath: nucleus ka qutr (diameter), atom ka qutr, insan ka qad, Zameen ka qutr, Suraj tak faasla, qareeb tareen sitare tak faasla, Milky Way ka qutr aur qareeb tareen galaxy tak faasla.
blocks.caption: Kuch faslon ka order of magnitude (For Your Information; kitab ke chart ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Yeh scale bhi das ki taqaton (powers of ten) mein hai: har bara nishan pichhle se 10^10 guna bara faasla hai. Atom taqreeban 10^-10 m, insan taqreeban 1 m, Zameen ka qutr taqreeban 10^7 m aur Suraj tak faasla taqreeban 1.5 x 10^11 m hai. Kitab qareeb tareen galaxy ka faasla taqreeban 10^28 m ke paas chhapti hai; asal mein qareeb tareen bari galaxy (Andromeda) taqreeban 2 x 10^22 m door hai, is liye yahan use Milky Way ke qutr (taqreeban 10^21 m) ke foran neeche rakha gaya hai.

items: Sab hindse 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 significant hain. Sifr significant ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi, in qawaid ke mutabiq.
Do significant figures ke darmiyan ka sifr khud significant hai.
Significant figures ke baen ke sifr significant nahi: 0.00467 ya 02.59 mein koi sifr significant nahi.

Significant figure ke daen ke sifr significant ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi. Decimal fraction mein yeh significant hain: 3.570 ya 7.4000 ke sab sifr significant hain. 8,000 kg jaise integers mein significant sifron ki tadaad napne wale instrument ki precision se tay hoti hai: 1 kg ke least count ke saath chaar significant figures hain, 8.000 x 10^3 kg likhe jate hain; 10 kg ke least count ke saath teen, 8.00 x 10^3 kg, aur isi tarah aage.
Jab paimaish scientific notation ya standard form mein record ho to das ki taqaton ke ilawa ke hindse significant hain: 8.70 x 10^4 kg mein teen significant figures hain.

blocks.text: (ii) Adad ko zarb ya taqseem karna

Hasil-e-zarb ya hasil-e-taqseem mein significant figures ki tadaad sab se kam durust factor, yani sab se kam significant figures wale factor, se zyada na rakhein. Maslan calculator (5.348 x 10^-2 x 3.64 x 10^4) / 1.336 = 1.45768982 x 10^3 deta hai. Chunke hisab mein sab se kam durust factor 3.64 x 10^4 mein teen significant figures hain, jawab sirf teen significant figures tak likha jaye; baqi hindse ghair-aham hain aur hataye jate hain. Hatate waqt rakha jane wala aakhri significant figure in qawaid se round off hota hai:

items: Agar giraya jane wala pehla hindsa 5 se kam ho to rakha jane wala aakhri hindsa jaisa hai waisa rehta hai.
Agar giraya jane wala pehla hindsa 5 se zyada ho to rakhe jane wale hindse mein ek barhaya jata hai.

Agar giraya jane wala hindsa 5 ho to rakha jane wala pichhla hindsa taaq (odd) hone par ek barhaya aur juft (even) hone par waisa hi rakha jata hai. Teen significant figures tak round karte hue, hindse ek ek kar ke hatate hue: 43.75 se 43.8; 56.8546 se 56.9; 73.650 se 73.6; 64.350 se 64.4.

blocks.text: Is qaide par chalte hue hisse (ii) ke hisab ka durust jawab 1.46 x 10^3 hai.
(iii) Adad jama ya tafreeq karne mein

Jawab mein rakhe jane wale decimal places ki tadaad jama ya tafreeq hone wali quantities mein se kisi ke sab se kam decimal places ke barabar honi chahiye; yahan significant figures ki tadaad aham nahi, decimal ki jagah aham hai. Maslan, metres mein quantities jama karna: (i) 72.1 + 3.42 + 0.003 = 75.523, durust jawab 75.5 m, kyunke 72.1 ke decimal places sab se kam hain; (ii) 2.7543 + 4.10 + 1.273 = 8.1273, durust jawab 8.13 m, kyunke 4.10 ke decimal places sab se kam hain.

blocks.caption: Thumb rules (Remember Thumb Rule aur Thumb Rule for Uncertainty boxes)
rows: Aakhri nateeje ki jama ya tafreeq
Aakhri nateeje ki zarb ya taqseem
ek jaisi accuracy (significant figures ki ek jaisi tadaad)
Bohat si readings ki ausat qeemat
uncertainty = ausat qeemat se mean deviation
timing device ka least count oscillations ki tadaad par taqseem karein

blocks.text: Significant figures uncertainty ke sirf ek zariye se nimatte hain, jo scale parhne mein shamil hai. Asal tajurbati uncertainties mein bohat se hisse hote hain, jin mein zaati ghaltiyan aur kabhi chhupi hui systematic ghaltiyan shamil hain. Scale reading jitni ijazat de us se behtar nahi kiya ja sakta, magar kul uncertainty us se kahin zyada ho sakti hai jitni paimaishon ke significant figures batate hain.

blocks.prompt: Quick Quiz: 0.0054 m, 0.03030 m, 40.0 m, 0.5 m aur 8.20 x 10^7 m mein significant figures ki tadaad batayein; phir munasib significant figures tak 2602 kg + 36.02 kg + 54.1 kg, 3.54 kg - 2.4 kg, aur 2.45 x 10^4 m x 2.46 m / 3.6 m dein.
blocks.explanation: 0.0054 m mein do hain (shuru ke sifr nahi ginte); 0.03030 m mein chaar (darmiyan ka sifr aur decimal fraction ka aakhri sifr ginte hain); 40.0 m mein teen; 0.5 m mein ek; 8.20 x 10^7 m mein teen. Jama sab se kam decimal places rakhti hai: 2602 + 36.02 + 54.1 = 2692.12, jo 2692 kg likha jaye (2602 se, koi decimal place nahi); 3.54 - 2.4 = 1.14, jo 1.1 kg (2.4 se ek decimal place). Zarb sab se kam significant figures rakhti hai: 2.45 x 10^4 x 2.46 / 3.6 = 1.674 x 10^4, jo 1.7 x 10^4 m (3.6 se do figures).

items: Significant figures = durust maloom hindse jama pehla mashkook hindsa; yeh istemal hua instrument dikhate hain (3.145 g ke muqable 3.1 g). Ginna: ghair-sifr hindse; darmiyan ke sifr; decimals ke aakhri sifr; integers ke sifr least count se (8.000 x 10^3 kg); power of ten se pehle ke hindse.

Zarb ya taqseem: sab se kam significant figures rakhein (1.46 x 10^3); round: 5 se kam rakhein, zyada par ek barhayein, bilkul 5 par juft ki taraf (43.75 -> 43.8, 64.350 -> 64.4). Jama ya tafreeq: sab se kam decimal places rakhein (75.5 m, 8.13 m). Significant figures sirf scale parhne ki uncertainty dhakte hain.
